summary: Frontend Coding Agent implemented the full production code for NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability). 7 new/updated files: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema with idb library), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes, closeSession, quota purge), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time crash detection with snapshot validation), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand store bridging services to React), useAutoSave.ts (interval + beforeunload), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible modal with role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby), and ResumePrompt/index.ts (barrel export). All data-testid attributes added per E2E test contract. Code pushed to branch feature/18-nfr-rel-001-frontend-tests.

artifacts.name: IndexedDB Schema
artifacts.description: Database schema, types, error classes, and connection management using idb library

artifacts.name: Persistence Service
artifacts.description: Atomic dual-store writes (saveSnapshot), closeSession, loadSnapshot, purgeOldSnapshots, purgeSession

artifacts.name: Crash Recovery Service
artifacts.description: Boot-time crash detection (detectCrash), snapshot validation (isValidSnapshot), corrupted data purge, discardRecovery

artifacts.name: Persistence Store
artifacts.description: Zustand store: triggerAutoSave, markSessionClosed, checkForRecovery, acceptRecovery, rejectRecovery

artifacts.name: useAutoSave Hook
artifacts.description: Interval-based auto-save (5s default) + beforeunload listener for graceful session close

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt Component
artifacts.description: Accessible modal: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby, data-testid attributes, Resume/Discard buttons
